ratings_why.fun: Watching the Hold land each Start of Turn is a good rhythm, but most arrival payoffs are plain +1/+1 packets, so the board grows in a familiar way.
ratings_why.distinct: A face-down Hold, goods that arrive late, and paying-now versus seizing-on-quiet-turns plays unlike any of today's tribes; Birds' return-to-hand is the only near neighbour.

verdict_why: Officer Nyx's return to the Hold leaves it unclear whether those units come Ashore again, and that changes how Pup, Jasmine and the fleet build read.

points.text: Officer Nyx sends fielded units back to the Hold; say whether they come Ashore again next turn (re-firing Mudslide Pup, Tibby, Skipper) and whether Old Jasmine counts them again.
The otter-and-heron split reads well in the shop (otters pay, herons wait), but the herons are on your side; one card where Customs costs you something, then pays off, would sell the comedy pair.
Old Jasmine's text is mostly exceptions; with the count shown on the card, the Pebble Jack and Nan lines could move to a rules tooltip so the card reads at a glance.

Tibby Slick, Reedwhistle and Lantern Skipper all say 'when a unit comes Ashore, +1/+1 to someone'; giving one a delta-flavoured twist (e.g. buff the unit in the slot it lands beside) would make arrivals feel less samey.
Creel Hauler is the clearest 'contraband in the creels' card; a second fight card that reads the Hold would thicken the thin combat identity the risks admit.

standouts.why: Officer Nyx fielding hidden cargo the opponent couldn't see is the smuggling fantasy acted out in the fight.
Lantern Reach Lookout's Back Channel is 'buying outside the shop' in one readable line.
Mudslide Pup says the tribe's deal at a glance: arrive late, arrive bigger.

weakest.why: Reedwhistle is a generic arrival buffer with no delta flavour in what it does.
Pipe Stoker's Confiscation Fire idea is lost; it reads as a generic sell-trigger buff.
Old Jasmine is a plain Start of Combat team buff wrapped in three lines of exceptions.

flags.note: Units returned to the Hold after the fight: do they come Ashore again and re-trigger Ashore effects?
Nan Silverholt with Pebble Jack makes two Created copies per arrival; with Pipe Stoker that is a lot of fuel each turn.
Grisel Seizing the Back Channel at Tier 6 gives free Tier 6 units on quiet turns, as the risks note.
